𝗠𝗜𝗞𝗘 𝗗𝗘𝗙𝗘𝗡𝗦𝗢𝗥: 𝗧𝗛𝗘 𝗔𝗥𝗦𝗢𝗡𝗜𝗦𝗧 𝗔𝗖𝗧𝗜𝗡𝗚 𝗔𝗦 𝗧𝗛𝗘 𝗙𝗜𝗥𝗘𝗠𝗔𝗡!

Mike Defensor’s sudden obsession with "accountability" in flood control isn’t just a filthy joke, it’s a sick, cynical performance. Watching a man, incidentally who is/was GMA’s LAPDOG, who profited from the literal stripping of our mountains cry about corruption is like watching an arsonist sue the city for not providing enough water to put out his own fire.

THE ULTIMATE ENVIRONMENTAL BETRAYAL
There is no "ignorance" defense for Mike. As a former DENR Secretary, he was the nation’s chief guardian of our forests and watersheds. He knows the physics of disaster. He knows that when Majestic Earth Core Ventures Inc., his own fucking company, tears into the earth of Rizal, the protection for Metro Manila vanishes.
He didn't just fail his mandate; he cannibalized it. He took the secrets of the environment he was sworn to protect and turned them into a business model for destruction.

PROFITEERING FROM THE DELUGE
While Mike is busy hurling accusations to build political capital, the families in Rizal and Marikina are busy shoveling his "Majestic" mud out of their homes.
 • The Rhetoric: He screams about stolen funds.
 • The Reality: He is the Chairman of a quarrying giant that environmentalists have explicitly linked to the worsening, "super malala" flooding that displaces thousands.
Every time the Marikina River rises, it carries the silt of Mike Defensor’s greed. You don’t get to lecture the country on "integrity" when your own wealth is built on the excavation of our safety.

THE SILENCE OF THE SCALP-HUNTER
Where was this passion for accountability when preservation advocates were raising red flags about his own operations? Where is the "transparency" regarding the environmental impact of his company’s excavation sites? It’s easy to point a fvcking finger when your own filthy hand is hidden behind a corporate board. But the people aren't blind. You can’t wash away the blood and mud with a loud press release.

Mike, stop shitting looking for corruption in the government’s budget and start looking for it in your own fvcking quarry’s ledger. Your credibility hasn’t just been questioned, it’s been excavated, sold by the ton, and washed away in the last typhoon.

Note: To all #DDShits coming and barking saying this is false news, PROVE ME WRONG OR SHUT THE FUCK UP! 
@HouseofRepsPH @senatePH @MikeDefensor
